benzene.fusion_reference: Oliver, Eaton and Huffman (1948), selected row in NIST Chemistry WebBook

water.melting_reference: IAPWS ice Ih release, normal-pressure melting temperature

antoine_bar.reference: Bridgeman and Aldrich (1964), coefficients tabulated by NIST

ethanol.melting_reference: Haida, Suga et al. (1977), crystalline I to liquid, NIST

antoine_bar.reference: Kretschmer and Wiebe (1949), coefficients tabulated by NIST

solid_model: Only pure benzene(s), constant fusion enthalpy and delta_Cp=0. All SLLE tutorial temperatures are above the melting points of water and ethanol. Solid solutions, hydrates and other solids are not supplied.
saft_parameters: Bundled Haslam et al. (2020) database, unchanged. All unlike dispersion pairs present. Published absence of aCH-CH2OH association is kept (no invented hydrogen-bond interaction).
cosmo_parameters: Compiled openCOSMO-RS default_turbomole unless THERMOWEAVE_COSMO_PARAMETERS explicitly overrides it. Turbomole COSMO_TZVPD_FINE conformers are external user-provided inputs.
